name: Spin Down
summary: Remove a track from a turntable playlist: the needle lifts, the record spins down and rolls away
about: Spin Down is a playlist on a walnut turntable. Removing the track that is playing lifts the tonearm, lets the platter slow to a stop, then the record rolls off the deck and out of the frame while the next one rolls in and starts spinning. Other rows slide their little record out of the sleeve as they go, the total time counts down, and Undo rolls the removed record back.
how: Tap a track name to play it, or use play and pause and the 33 or 45 speed keys.
Press the minus button (or the cross on any row) to remove a track.
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) within six seconds to roll it back into the list.
If the crate runs empty, Put the records back refills it.
